description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs has_key_cert_sign() and cert_basic_constraints() iterate over extensions with a for loop and an early return. Both could be written with .find().and_then().map() which is idiomatic Rust for Option-chained lookups. The for-loop versions are readable but inconsistent with Rust style — a contributor will copy the for-return pattern when adding new extension parsers. Rewrite: cert.tbs_certificate.extensions.as_ref()?.iter().find(|e| e.extn_id == OID_KEY_USAGE).and_then(|ext| KeyUsage::from_der(ext.extn_value.as_bytes()).ok()).map(|ku| ku.key_cert_sign()). Same transformation for cert_basic_constraints.
title: has_key_cert_sign and cert_basic_constraints use for-return instead of iterator chain
